UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with cumulative KOF Peggle statistics and progression

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: Public display name of the player

highScore.description: Highest score achieved across all stages

stagesUnlocked.description: Number of unlocked stages in Adventure Mode

totalPegsHit.description: Lifetime count of pegs hit by the player

totalFeverCount.description: Lifetime count of Extreme Fever modes triggered

createdAt.description: Timestamp when profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

ScoreRecord.title: ScoreRecord
ScoreRecord.description: Individual stage completion score record for a player

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the score owner

recordId.description: Unique identifier for this game session record

score.description: Final score earned in the session

masterUsed.description: Name of the KOF Peggle Master used (e.g. Kyo, Iori)

cleared.description: Whether all orange pegs were cleared

createdAt.description: Timestamp when record was logged via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when record was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/records/{recordId}.description: Subcollection of stage scores logged by the user
